notes.title: 『Adventure Bar Story』 updated to version 1.0.1.
notes.content:
We have added and fixed the following three features.

①Implemented autosave
We have decided to perform an autosave when you "open" a store.
We have added an autosave slot to the top of the loading screen.

②Added "Custom" to keyboard controls
You can select this in Option → System → Keyboard "Configurations".
You can go to the customization screen from the menu button.

③Changed the default setting of "Vsync" to OFF
This is a change to the default settings, so there will be no changes for users who have already played the game.
If you find that your cursor or character movement is too fast, try turning off the "Vsync" setting, which can be set in Option → System.

Thank you for your cooperation.
